# Riah To-Do
> Today's list as a note by the Windows clock — one JSON file, no server, no accounts. Part of Riah Studio.
> Last updated: 2026-08-16
> Repo: https://github.com/RiahStudio/riah-todo

## What this is
- Windows tray to-do list that sits by the clock.
- One local JSON file; no server, no accounts, no telemetry.
- Keyboard-first, always visible.

## Quick facts
- Developer: Riah Studio (Riah Harris)
- Platform: Windows (tray app)
- Data: one local JSON file (user owns it)

## For agents
- Public repo — indexable, cloneable.
- Build/install instructions in README.md.
- RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md documents the release process.
